# DatIQ: The Unified Web Intelligence Platform — Full Content
> Comprehensive content reference for AI agents and crawlers.
> For the short discovery index, see /llms.txt.
> Tagline: Intelligence from Web.
> Brand: DatIQ (one word; capital I, capital Q).

---

## 1. Disambiguation

DatIQ (this product) is an AI-enabled web intelligence platform for extracting structured data from any public URL. It is NOT related to:
- "DAT iQ" / "DATiQ" — a freight rate intelligence product by IntelliTrans / Trimble (North American trucking market)
- "DAT" (without "iQ") — the parent DAT freight & load-board company
- "Data IQ" / "DataIQ" — a generic analytics consultancy term, used by multiple unrelated firms

DatIQ.app is the canonical product. The brand is styled "DatIQ" (one word, capital I, capital Q).

---

## 2. What DatIQ Does

DatIQ runs a five-step loop over the public web — **read, reason, watch, act, share** — and extraction is only the first step.

1. **Read.** Paste a URL and receive structured data from any publicly accessible page.
2. **Reason.** Run a workflow template that turns those fields into the finished artefact the work was for: an account brief, a competitive comparison, a scored account list, a discoverability audit.
3. **Watch.** Put competitor pages under a watchlist that re-reads them on a cadence and classifies how much each change matters.
4. **Act.** Route the changes and results that clear your bar into Slack, email, a webhook or a CRM.
5. **Share.** Publish any result as a report at its own link, with a visibility level you choose per report.

**The governing rule.** Every field DatIQ returns is **observed** (read off a page, with the page and the supporting quote recorded), **inferred** (derived, and explicitly labelled as inferred), or **absent**. There is no fourth state and no plausible-looking default. Consequently every score carries a **coverage** figure, and an unmeasured signal is excluded with its weight redistributed rather than scored as zero — because scoring a missing measurement as zero would depress every score during a third-party outage and then show a phantom improvement when it recovered.

From step one alone, users immediately receive:

- **Structured headings** (H1–H6) in document order
- **Internal and external links**, AI-categorized
- **AI-generated summary** in plain language
- **Contact information** (leadership names, email addresses, social profiles) when "Contacts & emails" is enabled
- **Pricing data** (structured tiers) when extracted
- **Custom fields** described in plain English — "extract all board members with titles", "find every API endpoint mentioned", etc.
- **Domain map** — every indexed URL on the site (when "Map entire domain" is enabled)
- **PDF / CSV export** of all of the above

No code required. Background processing keeps the page responsive. Results persist to your account and are re-loadable on any device.

---

## 3. Core Capabilities (Detailed)

### Web extraction
- Headings H1 through H6 in document order
- All internal and external links, with text and aria-label
- Page metadata: title, description, OpenGraph, Twitter Card
- JavaScript rendering option (via Firecrawl `waitFor: 3000`) for SPAs
- Honors `robots.txt` by default. The check runs server-side before any page is
  fetched, identifying as `DatIQBot/1.0`, and honors any published Crawl-delay.
  A disallowed URL is declined without being requested and without being charged.
  A signed-in user who records a confirmation that they own a site, or have the
  owner's permission, can override that refusal for that one site.

### AI summary
- Plain-language overview of any page
- Model: Google Gemini by default, falling back to Anthropic Claude then OpenAI (configurable per deployment)
- 2-3 sentence default; longer for rich content

### Custom extraction
- User describes any field in plain English
- Examples: "Extract every executive with their title and LinkedIn URL", "Pull all product SKUs and prices", "Find every API endpoint mentioned"
- Returns structured JSON ready for export

### Domain mapping
- Discovers every URL on a site that is crawlable
- Routes to Firecrawl's `/map` endpoint
- Searchable list view; click any URL to extract

### Contact extraction
- Surface leadership names, email addresses, social profiles
- Auto-populates a leadership/board contact prompt
- One-click Quick Enrichment button on the preview page

### Pricing extraction
- Structured pricing tiers from any pricing page
- Captures plan names, prices, billing cadence, key features
- Excel-ready output

### Content generation
- SEO Blog Outline — heading structure + meta + key topics
- Competitor Summary — side-by-side teardown
- Social Posts — 3-5 LinkedIn / X posts from any extracted page
- Compare — 2-URL battlecard
- Explain — plain-English explainer for any page

### Scheduled monitoring
- Hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly
- Alert on change (heading, link, content hash, or custom field)
- Email + in-app notification
- Pro and above

### Batch processing
- Started from the Home composer — paste a list, import a CSV, or drop one on the box. There is no separate Batch tab.
- Multiple URLs in one run, 3 extracted in parallel
- Per-URL status (success / fail / retry), with filter by All / Success / Failed and sorting
- Run in background — a run survives navigation; progress shows in a dock with live count, current URL, and Cancel
- Every run has its own link, so results (including failures) reopen after a reload or days later
- Only successful pages become Dashboard entries, so the run page is where a failed URL and its Retry live
- CSV bulk export
- Pro and above

### Export & integrations
- **CSV** — comprehensive, every enrichment included (deep-flattened JSON paths)
- **PDF** — formatted report, same complete content
- **Markdown** / **JSON** — paste straight into a doc or pipe into a script
- **Google Sheets** — Open-in-Google-Sheets with one click
- **HubSpot** — push contacts and companies with property mapping
- **Airtable** — push rows into the table you choose, with auto-built field map
- **Notion** — push into the database you choose, with property mapping
- **Slack** — push new extractions + change alerts to the channel you choose
- **Zapier** — trigger 5,000+ apps on new extractions (DatIQ private app)
- **Webhooks** — fire-and-forget POST on extraction complete
- **Email delivery** — send extractions to any address
- **Server-stored connections** — every destination above is set up once in /account#integrations; tokens are stored server-side and never re-displayed
- **API** — POST /api/extract, POST /api/ai, GET /api/stats; bearer-token access via /api/v1 (Business + Agency)
- **White-label PDF** (Business + Agency) — upload a single-page PDF template; every export renders on top of it

---

### Discoverability audits (SEO / AEO / GEO)

DatIQ scores a page for three audiences that reward different things, because a
page can rank well in classic search and never be quoted by an answer engine.

- **SEO** — crawlability, rendering, canonicals, Core Web Vitals
- **AEO** — answer-first passages an assistant can lift and quote whole
- **GEO** — machine-readable entity identity and citation footprint

Four pillars sit underneath, each traceable to its individual signals: Answer
Clarity (30%), Entity Authority (25%), Structural Hierarchy (20%), Technical
Accessibility (25%).

Blocking failures — a noindex directive, AI crawlers disallowed in robots.txt,
content that only exists after JavaScript runs — apply a multiplicative penalty
to every framework score rather than a fixed deduction, and the report shows the
arithmetic.

Signals that could not be measured (Core Web Vitals when PageSpeed has no field
data, citation footprint when no answer-engine sampling is configured) are
EXCLUDED and their weight redistributed, never scored as zero. Every score
reports its evidence coverage alongside it.

Findings become a prioritised queue with owner, effort, confidence and the score
this specific page can recover. Where a fix is markup or copy, DatIQ generates a
draft from the page's own content — FAQPage JSON-LD built from visible
questions, Organization schema carrying real profile links, 40-60 word answer
blocks, corrected heading outlines. Anything unobservable is emitted as an
explicit TODO placeholder rather than invented.

Re-auditing compares against the previous run and reports resolved, remaining
and newly introduced issues. A delta is only reported when both audits measured
the same signal.

Audits carry their own monthly allowance, separate from extraction credits:
Free 3, Go 10, Select 25, Pro 100, Business 500, Agency 2,000. Scheduled
monitoring requires Pro or above; competitive benchmarks require Select or above.

DatIQ makes no claim that a score predicts rankings, citations or traffic.


### Intelligence workflows (templates)
A workflow template is a named end-to-end job: an input form, the fields DatIQ reads, the analysis it runs, and the output blocks returned. Twenty ship today in the template hub, filtered by role and by module; a template can serve several roles. Some are hand-offs (for example Competitor Change Monitor, ICP List → CRM, Price-change Alert to Slack, Business Truth Setup): they open the right screen with the fields already filled in and never run or charge on their own. Among the templates that run:
- **Sales-ready Account Brief** (sales) — a company framed for a discovery call, a displacement, or an expansion
- **Bulk ICP Account Enrichment** (sales / RevOps) — a list of domains in, a scored account table out
- **Competitor Pricing Tracker** (competitive intelligence) — a pricing page as a structured tier table you can diff later
- **Customer Proof Extractor** (competitive intelligence) — every named customer, case study, logo and quantified outcome on a site
- **AI Visibility & Competitive Brief** (competitive intelligence / marketing) — you and up to four competitors read under one shared schema
- **SEO / GEO / AEO Audit** (SEO) — a page scored for classic search, answer engines and generative engines
- **Pre-Meeting Due Diligence Brief** (founder / VC) — a source-backed company brief before a first call

Every run shows a cost estimate before it starts and spends nothing until confirmed. Runs are saved with their inputs, outputs and sources, and can be re-opened, exported or published as a report. On the Go plan and above, any template can be duplicated and edited — its fields, prompts and output blocks — without modifying the shipped original.

### Bulk account intelligence and ICP scoring
- Import up to 500 company domains by paste or CSV; normalised and de-duplicated on import
- Durable chunked enrichment that survives a closed tab, a lost connection or a slow provider
- Firmographics read from each company's own site: industry, size band, pricing model, whether pricing is published, positioning, proof points, contacts
- Customer-editable ICP rules: field, operator, value, weight, plus required criteria and a qualification threshold (default 50)
- Live rule testing against a sample domain before committing a run
- Unmeasured criteria excluded and their weight redistributed, never scored as zero; coverage reported alongside every score; a zero-coverage account returns no score rather than a zero
- Review queue holding low-confidence extractions for confirmation instead of admitting them silently
- Export as CSV or JSON, or push to HubSpot, Notion, Airtable or Slack with scores, coverage and source URLs attached
- Uses the plan's batch allowance: 5 accounts on Free, 20 Go, 50 Select, 100 Pro, 250 Business, 500 Agency and Developer

### Competitor watchlists and change intelligence
- Standing watches that re-read chosen competitor domains on a cadence
- Page discovery: adding a domain crawls its homepage and suggests the pages worth monitoring; suggested pages are labelled distinctly from user-added ones, because every monitored page is a recurring crawl charged to the customer
- Materiality classification drives delivery: **critical** (a price or tier change) alerts immediately, **high** (a feature claim or positioning shift) batches daily, **medium** weekly, **low** (whitespace, a copyright year) is recorded and never alerts, **unknown** goes to review rather than being guessed at
- The first run of any watchlist is a silent baseline — there is nothing to compare against yet, and a tool that alerts on setup teaches users to ignore its alerts
- A field that stopped being observed is reported as unobserved, never as a deletion, because a failed page render is far more common than a competitor removing their pricing
- Objective change facts (old value, new value, page, timestamp) are kept structurally separate from labelled AI interpretation, with per-record feedback
- Uses the plan's scheduled-monitoring allowance, which starts on Select

### Signal routing
- If-this-then-that rules over the whole platform
- Triggers: a competitor watchlist change, a bulk enrichment result (for example an account crossing the ICP threshold), or a workflow run finishing
- Conditions combine and must all be satisfied
- Actions: **Slack**, **email**, **webhook**, **HubSpot**
- "Test with sample payload" shows the verdict and which conditions matched, using the same evaluator as the live runtime
- Every dispatch is recorded whether it succeeded or not; unreachable destinations are retried on a backoff schedule; destinations are re-validated at dispatch time rather than only at save time
- Available from the Select plan upwards, alongside integrations
- A rule listens either to every source of its kind or to chosen lists/watchlists only. A rule that loses its last chosen source is paused with the reason shown — it never widens to 'everything' — and deleting a list or watchlist that rules use names those rules first
- The editor reads each rule back as one sentence before it is saved

### Workflow hub
- Lists, watchlists and rules on one screen, because they are one pipeline
- Order: needs your attention, building blocks (with a starter template for any block not set up), your pipelines (pause/resume in place), not connected yet (every list or watchlist no active rule hears), recent runs
- Dry trace: pick an event and see which rules would fire and which condition turned the others away; nothing is sent

### Engagement (private beta)
- Consent-first email outreach to accounts already researched in DatIQ, for invited beta users; request access at hello@datiq.app
- Opt-outs are per channel and checked at the moment of sending, not only at approval; every message is approved by a person first
- A message that cannot be sent is recorded as failed, never reported as sent
- Prospects import from CSV, TSV, TXT or Excel, with every row checked before anything is imported

### Shareable reports
- Any run, audit or extraction can be published as a report at its own link
- Five visibility levels: **private**, **anyone with the link** (unlisted), **workspace only**, **specific people** (named email addresses), **public**
- Only public reports are indexable; every other level ships a noindex instruction
- Revocation is permanent and the code is never reissued; reports can also carry an expiry date
- Business and Agency plans replace DatIQ attribution with the customer's own Brand Kit across reports, PDF exports and emailed deliverables
- Sharing is free on every plan, including Free

### Team workspaces
- Shared containers with owner, admin and member roles; the seat count includes the owner
- Invites are email-bound, single-use and expire after 14 days
- A member's seat can be paused: they keep read access but cannot spend the workspace allowance
- Reports set to workspace visibility are readable by every member

### Usage and credits
- Any job that reads more than one page shows an estimate before it starts: pages expected and AI calls expected
- The usage ledger records what each job actually consumed, itemised, and reconciles actuals against the estimate
- Capabilities reuse the allowance that already describes their work rather than introducing separate currencies: template runs draw on extractions, bulk lists on batch size, watchlists on scheduled monitoring, signal rules on integrations, and audits on their own monthly allowance

## 4. Pricing (as of 2026)

Everything is sold in ONE unit: credits. 1 credit = one page fetch; a fast AI call is 2, a deep one 5, an enriched account-list row 3, a Discoverability audit 19. USD and INR are SET prices, not conversions of one another.

| Plan | Price (USD/mo) | Price (INR/mo) | Credits / month | Batch | Bulk list | Monitors | Key features |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | ₹0 | 500, one-time, never resets | 5 | 1 | 1 | No credit card, headings + links + summary, export (PDF, JSON, CSV & Markdown), email export, 1 monitor |
| Go | $5 | ₹449 | 1,500 | 20 | 20 | 2 | + CSV import, fork & edit templates, 2 monitors |
| Select | $15 | ₹1,449 | 5,000 | 50 | 50 | 5 | + integrations (HubSpot, Notion, Airtable, Slack), signal routing, competitor watchlists |
| Pro | $25 | ₹2,449 | 10,000 | 100 | 100 | 10 | + Google Sheets push |
| Developer | $55 | ₹5,449 | 25,000 | 250 | 200 | 10 | API-first, JSONL / RAG export (upcoming) |
| Business | $85 | ₹7,849 | 50,000 | 250 | 250 | 25 | + API, 3 seats, HubSpot CRM sync, white-label PDF, priority support |
| Agency | $200 | ₹19,449 | 150,000 on fair use | 500 | 500 | 100 | + 5 client workspaces, white-label PDF, priority support |
| Enterprise | Custom ≥$1,000 | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom | SSO, DPA, SLA, on-prem |

Monthly prices shown; annual billing is billed twelve months upfront and works out cheaper per month (Go $4 / ₹379, Select $12 / ₹1,209, Pro $20 / ₹2,049, Developer $45 / ₹4,549, Business $70 / ₹6,549, Agency $165 / ₹16,249). Unused plan credits roll over for one month, so an account holds at most two months' worth. INR prices exclude 18% GST, added at checkout. GST invoices on every payment.

**Credit packs** — 750 for $5 / ₹490, 3,000 for $19 / ₹1,849, 15,000 for $89 / ₹8,749. Any plan including Free; they never expire.

**Capacity add-ons** — Scheduled Monitor $5 / ₹449 per slot, Batch Pack $9 / ₹849 per 50 rows, Extra Workspace $19 / ₹1,849. An add-on buys the right to do something; the runs still cost credits.

**Your price is fixed for the period you paid for.** If prices or plan limits change while you are subscribed you keep what you bought for the rest of that period, and any increase reaches you straight away. A repricing applies at renewal, never mid-period.

### Plan-level features
- **White-label PDF** (Business + Agency): upload a single-page PDF template in /account; every PDF export and invoice is rendered on top of your branded background.
- **Priority support** (Business + Agency): contact-form submissions are routed through a faster SLA.
- **Extra Workspace add-on**: same features as the parent plan, capped at the parent plan's team-seats limit (e.g. 3 seats on Business).
- **Enterprise**: SSO, DPA, SLA, on-prem — contact sales.

### Billing
- Razorpay + UPI for Indian customers (auto-detected)
- Stripe for international cards
- Numbered, itemized invoice or receipt issued on every payment
- PDF invoice emailed automatically
- View, download, and re-send every invoice from the Account screen
- GSTIN captured on every Indian invoice

## 5. Target Users (Personas)

DatIQ asks which of eight roles fits your work. The role decides the examples, Home tiles and templates shown first; it never restricts a feature, and it can be changed at any time.

1. **Sales, SDR & BDR** — a sourced account brief and published contacts, pushed to the CRM.
2. **RevOps & Growth Operations** — clean, score and route account lists against ICP rules.
3. **Product Manager & Competitive Intelligence** — watch competitors; only material changes alert.
4. **Product Marketing Manager** — battlecards and claims built from competitor pricing, proof and positioning.
5. **SEO, Content, AEO & GEO** — SEO, AEO and GEO scores with copy-ready fixes.
6. **Brand, Growth & CRO** — an approved business truth record, share of voice, and trust scored by evidence.
7. **Founder, VC & Market Research** — sourced diligence briefs and market landscapes.
8. **Agency, Enterprise & Consultant** — the same research for many clients, in your brand.

## 6. Use Cases

### Account Intelligence (bulk ICP scoring)
Import up to 500 company domains, enrich each from their own public site, score them against ICP rules you control, and export or push a prioritised account table. Coverage and the source URL behind every field travel with the export, so a rep can see why an account qualified rather than only that it did.

### Competitive Monitoring
Standing watches on competitor pricing, features and positioning, with materiality classification so a price change alerts immediately and a copyright year never does. Routed to Slack, email, a webhook or HubSpot by a signal rule.

### AI Visibility
Read your site and up to four competitors under one identical schema, score each for classic search, answer engines and generative engines, and get a prioritised, evidence-backed brief on what to change first. A competitor whose site could not be read is explicitly named as unread rather than invented.

### Recruiting Research
Brief yourself on a company before a candidate call: what they build, how they position, who leads which function, and a watch on their careers pages. DatIQ surfaces only publicly published contact information and never guesses personal email addresses.

### Investor Diligence
A source-backed pre-meeting brief: product, pricing model, published traction signals, the team, and the questions worth asking — every claim carrying the page and quote behind it. Run a whole pipeline through the same template for a like-for-like comparison.

### Lead Generation
Extract contact info, company details, and LinkedIn profiles from any public-facing business page. Build prospect lists in minutes.
- Extract emails, phone numbers, job titles
- Capture company size, funding, industry
- Batch-process 100s of company URLs
- Export to CSV or push to CRM
- See: /use-cases/lead-generation

### Competitor Research
Monitor competitor pricing, feature pages, and messaging. Get AI-summarised insights on what changed and why.
- Track pricing page changes automatically
- Extract product features & positioning copy
- Compare multiple competitors side by side
- Scheduled monitoring with email alerts
- See: /use-cases/competitor-research

### SEO Audit
Extract headings, meta tags, structured data, and internal links to identify SEO gaps without expensive tooling.
- Extract H1–H6, title, meta description
- Identify missing schema markup
- Audit anchor text & link structure
- Batch-audit entire site in one run
- See: /use-cases/seo-audit

### Market Research
Aggregate product reviews, news articles, and industry reports into a structured dataset — ready for analysis.
- Scrape reviews from G2, Capterra, App Store
- Pull news headlines & publication dates
- Aggregate pricing across competitors
- Export structured JSON for analysis
- See: /use-cases/market-research

### Price Monitoring
Track product prices across competitors and marketplaces. Alerted when prices change.
- Monitor competitor prices daily or weekly
- Track your own product prices on marketplaces
- Historical price trend export
- Alert when price drops below threshold

### Content Research
Extract article structures, FAQs, and key topics from top-ranking pages to inform your content strategy.
- Extract article outlines & heading structure
- Identify questions & FAQs on ranking pages
- Aggregate content gaps across 20+ pages
- AI-generated content brief from any URL

### Additional use cases
- **HR & Recruiting** — job postings, candidate profiles, career pages
- **Real Estate Research** — property listings, rentals, neighbourhood data
- **E-commerce Catalogue** — product names, descriptions, SKUs, prices
- **Compliance Monitoring** — ToS, privacy policy, regulatory announcements
- **News & Media Monitoring** — headlines, press releases, brand mentions
- **API & Developer Data** — structured JSON for RAG / LLM pipelines

## 8. FAQ (12 questions and answers)

**Q1. What is DatIQ?**
DatIQ is an AI-enabled web intelligence platform that turns any public URL into structured data — headings, links, contacts, pricing, AI summaries, and custom fields — in seconds.

**Q2. How is DatIQ different from Clay, Browse.ai, or Firecrawl?**
DatIQ combines plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, and full CSV/PDF export in one AI-enabled product. It is significantly cheaper than Clay, simpler than Firecrawl, and more feature-rich than Browse.ai.

**Q3. How much does DatIQ cost?**
DatIQ is free to start — 500 credits, one-time and never resetting, no credit card. Everything is priced in one unit: 1 credit = one page fetch, a Discoverability audit is 19, a deep AI call 5, a fast one 2, an enrichment 3. Unused plan credits roll over for one month, so an account holds at most two months' worth. Paid plans start at $5 / ₹449 a month (Go, 1,500 credits). Select is $15 / ₹1,449 (5,000 credits, PDF export, 5 scheduled monitors, integrations and signal routing), Pro $25 / ₹2,449 (6,000 credits, 10 monitors), Business $85 / ₹7,849 (40,000 credits, API, 3 seats), Agency $200 / ₹19,449 (150,000 credits on fair use, 5 client workspaces, 100 monitors). Credit packs top up any plan, including Free — 750 for $5 / ₹490, 3,000 for $19 / ₹1,849, 15,000 for $89 / ₹8,749 — and never expire. Annual billing is cheaper again. USD and INR are set prices rather than conversions of one another, so the figure quoted is the figure charged. A plan's price and limits are fixed for the period you bought; a repricing takes effect at renewal, never mid-period.

**Q4. Do I need to write code to use DatIQ?**
No. DatIQ is AI-enabled — paste a URL, describe any field you want in plain English, and the AI extracts it. Custom extraction is configurable in the UI without scripting.

**Q5. What formats can I export?**
Export gives you CSV, PDF, Markdown and JSON as downloads, plus copy-to-clipboard, and you can email selected extractions from the Dashboard. PDF reports are customizable with white-label templates on Business and Agency plans. To send data to another tool instead of downloading it, use Push — HubSpot, Notion, Airtable and Slack (each connected once in Account → Integrations), plus Google Sheets, which needs no setup at all.

**Q6. Can I schedule recurring extractions?**
Yes. Scheduled monitoring is included from Select upward: 5 monitors on Select, 10 on Pro, 25 on Business and unlimited on Agency. Schedules can run hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly, and you can attach an alert email to be notified when the page changes.

**Q7. How does DatIQ handle JavaScript-heavy sites?**
The "Render JavaScript" option uses Firecrawl's headless browser with a 3-second wait, which works for React, Vue, Angular, and Next.js SPAs.

**Q8. Is my data private?**
Yes. Extractions are private to your account by default. You can hit "Share" on any extraction to publish a public read-only report at datiq.app/p/<slug>, but the dashboard and saved extractions are account-scoped.

**Q9. Does DatIQ support team workspaces?**
Yes. Business plans include 3 seats, Agency plans include 5 workspaces. Extra Workspace add-ons are available.

**Q10. Is DatIQ GDPR / DPDP / SOC 2 compliant?**
DatIQ is India-first and DPDP Act 2023 compliant. SOC 2 Type II is in progress (target Q4 2026). The admin page documents current compliance posture and DPIA templates.

**Q11. What AI model powers DatIQ?**
DatIQ runs AI enrichment through a provider fallback chain — Google Gemini, then Anthropic Claude, then OpenAI — configurable via env. The default model is optimized for structured extraction tasks. The API is also model-agnostic — you can plug in your own key.

**Q12. How do I cancel my subscription?**
Open Account → Plan → Cancel. You keep access until the end of the billing period, then the account moves to Free. No email hoops, no retention calls.

---

## 9. API

### Endpoints
- `POST /api/extract` — extract structured data from a URL
  - Body: `{ "url": "...", "options": { "renderJs": true, "customPrompt": "..." } }`
  - Returns: `{ "data": { "headings": [...], "links": [...], "summary": "...", "custom": {...} } }`
- `POST /api/ai` — AI enrichment on existing structured data
  - Body: `{ "data": {...}, "prompt": "Extract every executive with title and LinkedIn" }`
  - Returns: `{ "enrichment": {...} }`
- `GET /api/stats` — aggregate statistics (count, last extracted, etc.)
  - Returns: `{ "totalExtractions": ..., "byDomain": {...} }`

### Authentication
- Bearer token in `Authorization` header
- Tokens generated from the Account → API page (Business and Agency plans)
- Rate limits: 60 requests / minute, 10,000 / day (Business); unlimited (Agency)

### Documentation
Full reference: /help/index.html (DatIQ-Developer-API section)

---

## 10. Competitive Context

DatIQ is an AI-enabled alternative to:
- **Clay** — an order of magnitude cheaper; DatIQ's paid plans start at $5 / ₹449 a month vs Clay's $149/mo. DatIQ's enrichment is built into the extraction rather than bolted on, and it reads each company's own live site instead of serving a purchased database, so every field carries the page and quote it came from.
- **Browse.ai** — More feature-rich (custom extraction, AI enrichment tabs, scheduled monitoring, white-label PDF).
- **Firecrawl** — Simpler. No API key management, no scraping infrastructure to maintain.
- **Diffbot** — Much cheaper. Plain-English config vs ontology training.
- **PhantomBuster** — No proxy rotation costs, no browser quotas.

DatIQ's differentiation: plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, full CSV/PDF export with no setup, India-first (INR + Razorpay + UPI + DPDP), white-label ready.

## 12. Technical Stack

- **Frontend:** Vite 8 + React 19 + React Router 8
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + CSS custom-property design tokens
- **Icons:** lucide-react
- **Auth + DB:** Supabase (Postgres + auth)
- **Extraction:** Firecrawl (`/v1/scrape` + `/v1/map`)
- **AI enrichment:** Google Gemini, falling back to Anthropic Claude then OpenAI (configurable)
- **Serverless:** Netlify Functions (Node.js)
- **Payments:** Razorpay (India) + Stripe (international)
- **PDF export:** jsPDF (lazy-loaded, only on export click)
- **AI-discovery files:** `/llms.txt` (3.6KB index) and `/llms-full.txt` (17.8KB full content — this file)
- **Open Graph card:** `/og-card.jpg` (1376×768, used as `og:image` + `twitter:image` on every static surface)
- **Schema.org:** FAQPage on `/faq`, `/what-is-datiq`, and all 4 use-case detail pages; BreadcrumbList on 11 nested pages; Article on blog posts
- **Test framework:** Vitest (2,500+ tests) + Playwright (e2e smoke) + jsdom

## 14. How to Get Started

1. Visit https://datiq.app/
2. Paste any public URL into the composer
3. Click "Extract" — you get headings, links, and an AI summary in seconds
4. Try Quick Enrichment — one-click capabilities for contacts, leadership, social, mission, pricing
5. Save the extraction to your account (free plan: 10 / month)
6. Export as CSV, PDF, or open in Google Sheets
7. Optional: sign up for a paid plan to unlock scheduled monitoring, batch, API, and white-label PDF

No credit card required to start. No setup. No API keys. Just paste and go.

## 16. Recent releases (2026)

**September 2026 — Workflow hub, template hub, roles.** Signal rules can listen
to chosen lists and watchlists (and are paused, never widened, when they lose
the last one); the Workflow hub shows every pipeline on one screen with the
unwired pieces named; the template hub carries twenty templates filtered by
role, including hand-offs that set up a watchlist, list or rule for you; eight
roles replace the seven personas; and Engagement — consent-first outreach — is
in private beta. Three new use-case pages cover RevOps, product marketing and
brand & CRO.

**September 2026 — Intelligence workflows.** The platform layer above
extraction: workflow templates that return a finished artefact rather than raw
fields, bulk account intelligence with customer-editable ICP scoring and a
review queue, competitor watchlists with materiality classification and a silent
baseline, native signal routing into Slack / email / webhooks / HubSpot, and
shareable reports with five visibility levels. Five new use-case pages cover
account intelligence, competitive monitoring, AI visibility, recruiting research
and investor diligence. The evidence contract — observed, inferred, or absent,
never invented — is now enforced across every surface, with coverage reported
alongside every score.


**August 2026 — Discoverability module.** SEO, AEO and GEO audits with a
four-pillar scoring engine, prioritised fixes with copy-ready implementation
constructs, re-audit comparison, trend history, scheduled monitoring and
competitive benchmarks. Unmeasured signals are excluded rather than scored as
zero, and every score reports its evidence coverage.
